rationale: The assistant's first guess (bulb) was off, but it adjusted on the customer's reply, and on the third turn it correctly identified the padlock as a child lock that survives unplugging, with a hedged hold-Stop-for-3-seconds fix. The customer's microwave was working after that. No parts were recommended and no safety issues arose. Minor weaknesses: the opening guess was premature, and the second turn did not ask what the display showed, so the customer had to volunteer the L symbol, which was only partly prompted by 'check for a control/child lock'.</br>
